about: P1's loop plan: our own base topology as data (tools/body/topo.py builds it). Every number says what it is derived FROM: (a) the game's need, (b) a reference, (c) inherited. Lengths in metres, angles in degrees, counts in edges. The trunk lattice counts are tied: K_top = c_f + n_t + c_k (the neck half ring), K = c_f + n_b + c_k (the trunk's half ring below the arm), N_arm = 2 n_f + n_t + n_b (the arm root = the wrist template's ring), N_leg = K - 2 + b (the leg root = the ankle template's ring); topo.py checks them.

reference.head: godot/art/people/heroine.glb
reference.why: (b) the base woman's close surface (MakeHuman hm08, CC0) only as the shape; (a) OUR skeleton's bones place every station; (c) her approved head's open ring (94 points) is the neck's top, kept vertex for vertex

close.why: (a) the close-up: the cel terminator a smooth curve across breasts, shoulders, buttocks, thighs and calves (L1); 8.5 mm keeps a thigh's facet under 0.4 px at 9.4 px/cm; arm and leg 44 = the subdivided templates' wrist and ankle

play.why: (a) the play camera (her 40-60 px tall) at ~25k: arm and leg 22 = the templates' rings; the neck keeps 25 of the head ring's 48 points a side (a head LOD's ring)

far.why: (a) crowds at ~8k; v1 still carries the base templates (generated far hands and feet are open)

canvas.why: (a) a capsule chart for the trunk: horizontal rays from the trunk's middle, tilting up over the shoulders and neck and down under the hips, so every trunk point is hit once

trunk.why: (b) heights read off the reference's midline and the skeleton (spine_02 1.155, the breast's fold 1.37)

shoulder.why: (a) the arm root ring through the armpit's saddle (the dome) and over the deltoid (tilted half-way from the arm's axis to lateral); the trunk's hole is the root ring's canvas footprint plus one band of loops (~1.5-2 cm: 6 deg front and back, 1.5 cm under the saddle, 0.012 canvas-t over the shoulder top) so the loops between run evenly; its four corners (front fold, back fold, front and back of the shoulder top) are the shoulder's only poles

hip.why: (b) the leg crease plane: through the crotch's midline at y_c, rising 30 deg laterally (the groin crease to the hip's side) and 9 deg toward the front (the groin above the glute fold)

breast.why: (b) the window read off the reference: the inframammary fold (1.365) to the upper slope's end (1.49) at the apex's theta, 10-60 deg across; (a) concentric loops about the apex, a small grid cap

elbow.why: (a) three loops on the bend's bisector planes: the crease loop on the bisector, two fanned 14 deg about the hinge so they meet the crease on the flexor side and spread over the olecranon

knee.why: (a) the same at the knee: spread over the patella, met in the popliteal crease

limbs.why: (a) rings at the tier's spacing along each bone, perpendicular to it; the arm's first rings turn from the tilted root to the bone over 40% of the upper arm

build.about: Pass 2 (density by edge length): every count is a length over these spacings, rounded to the parity the junctions need (topo_build.py trunk_plan). Spacings in metres.

close.why: (a) the close-up at 9.4 px/cm: 7-8 mm on trunk and limbs (a 7 px chord), 5-6 mm over the breasts, shoulder caps, glutes and each joint's bend zone, so the cel terminator stays a curve (the old arm's 12 px chords failed); the neck graded to the head ring's ~4 mm; kites (reduction poles) on the inner/back side, mid-segment
close.why_pass3: (a) shoulder_gap: the rim the root ring offset 45 mm along the trunk, so the loops between run evenly (gap ratio <= 1.5); shoulder_spacing: the loops radial step; arm_root_n: the arm root after the trunk-side corner chains (the judge: ~40 close); upper_arm_band false: the shoulder zone (armpit + 110 mm) and the elbow zone leave no 40 mm-clear window for poles on the upper arm, so the elbow keeps the root count and the forearm reduces
close.why_pass3b_neck: (a) the neck meets her head ring one to one without folds: the reference front neck turns forward under the jaw where the canvas rays cannot follow (the rows bunched 15-28 mm below the ring) and the head ring (c: her approved head, kept) has 3-6 mm steps where its own rows end, some stepping back along the ring; neck_meet_rows: the top rows re-placed per side between the base row and the side own ring points (rows at even arc length on surface curves; neck_ring_smooth: the rail toward the ring smoothed by that many umbrella steps and sampled at the ring own arc fractions, so every row runs forward under a back-step; neck_step_ease: the steps rise eased into the rows by s^p); neck_untwist_rows: the top rows placed by a deterministic fold-lowering search in the tangent plane (the ring steps leave no quad under them convex otherwise). The midline columns carry the head own 2-3 mm midline offset and ease it to zero at the base row: the field is continuous through the midline, nothing crosses it (replaces the right-side-only snap + ease)

play.why: (a) the play camera (her 40-60 px tall) at ~25k: the same plan at 17 mm; the full 94-point neck ring kept (her head is drawn full at every tier), reduced just below the collarbones
